html:
Unique Research · Event · November 14, 2022

Why still talk “digital” in 2022? Brands and vendors still trip on myths: digital as end-in-itself; unclear which problems tools solve; shelf of SaaS with no insight behind the dashboards. Unique Research hosts the 2022 Brand Digital Innovation Development Forum in Shanghai on Nov 18 to open a practical new chapter for brand digitization — spanning MarTech selection, content/ops, experience, and go-global tooling. Keep the signup energy; agenda/speakers and registration live in CN source / UniqueBloom link on ingest.
